input.context: Colonists ne is activity ko dekhkar force badhane ke liye bhi bulaya tha. Advance front ko mazboot karne wale soldiers mein Colonel John Stark aur James Reid (dono baad mein generals bane) ke leadership mein 200 soldiers ki first aur third New Hampshire Regiment shamil thi. Stark ke aadmiyon ne colonists ki position ke north end par fence ke saath-saath apna मोर्चा sambhala. Jab pani ke kam flow ki wajah se peninsula ke north-east mein Mystic River par ek ditch ban gayi, tab unhone jaldi se us ek chhoti stone wall se north ki taraf fence aage tak badha diya, jo ki beach ke chhote kinare par khatam hoti hai. Gridley ya Stark ne fence ke aage 100 feet (30 meters) tak ek stake laga rakha tha aur order diya tha ki soldiers ke nikal jaane tak koi bhi goli nahi chalayega.

options: Colonizers ne power badhane ke liye bulaya tha

input.context: Soldier ants alag-alag stages mein ek line mein chalte hue colony aur ghar banati hain. Nomad stage mein, ants ki army raat mein march karti hai aur din ke time camp mein ruk jati hai. Jab khana kam ho jata hai toh settlement nomadic stage start karti hai. Is stage mein settlement temporary nests banati hai jinhe daily change kiya jata hai. Inmein se har nomad rush ya march lagbhag 17 days tak rehta hai.

input.context: Blog se students ki writing improve karne mein bhi help mil sakti hai. Jahan students apne blog experience ki shuruat aksar random grammar aur spelling ke saath karte hain, wahan audience ki presence se ismein generally change aata hai. Kyunki students aksar sabse critical audience hote hain, isliye blog writer criticism ya review se bachne ke liye apni writing improve karne ki koshish karne lagta/lagti hai. Saath hi blogging “students ko apne aas-paas ki duniya ke baare mein zyada information rakhne ke liye force karti hai.” Audience ki interest ko poora karne ki zaroorat students ko agile aur interesting banne ke liye inspire karti hai (Toto, 2004). Blogging ek aisa tool hai jo collaboration ko inspire karta hai, aur students ko traditional school days se behtar seekhne ke liye encourage karta hai. Blogs ka sahi use “students ko zyada analytical aur critical banane ke liye empower kar sakta hai; internet content par actively respond karke, students doosron ki writing ke context mein apni position define kar sakte hain. Saath hi kisi khaas topic par apna viewpoint online kar sakte hain (Oravec, 2002).
